title: NB I-280 De Anza debris (CHP 0750); San Tomas × Campbell hit-and-run (CHP 0656)

latest.place: Oakland area (East Bay; Campbell not felt)

items.label: I-280 NB · De Anza
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB I-280 just north of the De Anza Blvd onramp (I280 N / De Anza Blvd Onr / NB 280 JNO DE ANZA), San Jose (~9:06 AM PT; CHP 0750 / CAD 260911GG0750; ~37.334455, -122.036536). LE alert debris in lanes (1125) ~9:08–9:09 AM; unit assigned/enroute ~9:12 AM; still on GGCC board. Affects NB 280 / De Anza into west Campbell–Cupertino corridor.

items.label: San Tomas · Campbell Ave
items.text: Hit and run — no injuries at S San Tomas Aquino Rd × W Campbell Ave (60 S San Tomas Aquino Rd / S SAN TOMAS AQUINO RD X W CAMPBELL AVE), San Jose / Campbell (~8:25 AM PT; CHP 0656 / CAD 260911GG0656; ~37.285006, -121.976617). Note: CAD detail line conflict about NB 85 JSO Cottle — board location is San Tomas × Campbell. Local Campbell intersection.

items.label: SR-17 SB · Redwood Estates
items.text: Traffic hazard on SB SR-17 just south of the Redwood Estates offramp (SB 17 JSO Redwood Estates), San Jose (~7:13–7:14 PM PT; CHP 2525 / CAD 260910GG2525; ~37.158394, -121.982318). Slow lane. Affects mountain SB 17 toward Santa Cruz.

items.label: SR-17 SB · The Cats Statues
items.text: Traffic hazard on SB SR-17 at The Cats Statues (SB 17 JSO The Cats Statues), San Jose area (~7:06–7:11 PM PT; CHP 2516 / CAD 260910GG2516; FSP 0194 / 260910GGFSP0194; ~37.214999, -121.988170). Blocking slow lane; unit assigned/enroute ~7:10 PM PT. Affects Campbell↔Santa Cruz over-the-hill SB 17.

items.label: I-280 NB · Wolfe
items.text: No-injury traffic collision on NB I-280 at the Wolfe Rd offramp, San Jose / Cupertino edge (~9:54 AM PT; CHP 0934 / CAD 260910GG0934). CHP mobile detail log empty at check. May slow NB 280 near Wolfe — not Union Ave / 17 / 85 Campbell core.
